ex.note: Treat as antagonistic warmup to your quads. Just getting the blood moving.
Direct warmup for quads. Feel free to push the weight here to get the quads firing. Progress this lift week over week as normal.
Any variant as long as you bump weights as soon as your rep brackets are met.
You can do these on any implement.
Weighted, unweighted, etc. 3 sets of 20 per leg.
General shoulder warmup.
Narrow and Underhand grip. Think about pulling your elbows to your back pockets.
Try and sit higher on the seat/grip lower on the handles for your lower pec. Squeeze them bitches and work any partials.
You can do this with a cable machine too. Whichever is easiest. Feel the stretch.
Abs of choice.
Antagonist warmup for deadlifts. Focus on leg drive.
Deficit or normal. 5th set, drop weight and do beltless with a pause below the knee.
Main leg curl. Progress as a normal lift.
Cable or hammer strength row.
Don’t be afraid of body English as you fatigue.
